blocks.text: Sharing the soul of Kyrgyzstan
Founded by local nomads and horse lovers, we aim to share the soul of Kyrgyzstan with the world - one hoofbeat at a time.
Our guides are passionate about their homeland and dedicated to providing authentic, safe, and unforgettable horse trekking experiences.
It started with a love for home.
Kyrgyzstan has always been more than a destination to us. It is where we grew up, where our families have lived for generations, and where horses remain an important part of everyday life.
We created Nomad Discovery Tours to share that connection with travelers - not just by showing them the mountains, but by giving them the opportunity to experience them the way we do.
When you travel with us, you're not just a guest. You become part of our journey.
The people who lead the way
Ready to experience the real Kyrgyzstan?
Join us on a journey through the mountains, valleys, and nomadic traditions of Kyrgyzstan.

SETTINGS.name: Song-Kul Lake
SETTINGS.blurb: A high alpine lake ringed by mountains and nomad pastures. Golden evening light and wide-open skies with no one else around.

SETTINGS.name: Kel-Suu Lake
SETTINGS.blurb: Turquoise water winding between sheer canyon walls near the Chinese border. One of the most remote and dramatic places in the country.

SETTINGS.name: A yurt under the stars
SETTINGS.blurb: A quiet yurt camp on the jailoo (summer pasture), with a sky full of stars once the sun goes down.

SETTINGS.name: Skazka Canyon
SETTINGS.blurb: The "Fairy Tale" canyon: red and orange rock formations a short walk from the shore of Issyk-Kul.

FAQS.q: Can you keep it a secret from my partner?
FAQS.a: Yes. We only contact the person who sends the inquiry, and on the trip itself your guide will treat it like any other trek until the moment arrives.

FAQS.q: How far in advance should I get in touch?
FAQS.a: The earlier the better, especially for summer dates and remote places like Kel-Suu, which need permits and more planning. A few weeks ahead is usually workable for Song-Kul.
It depends on the setting, how many days, how many people and which extras you want. Send us your idea and we’ll reply with a quote.

FAQS.q: Can friends or family come along?
FAQS.a: Of course. Some couples want it to be just the two of them, others want family there for the celebration. Tell us who’s coming in the form.
